options.name: api_path
options.description: Base NITRO API path. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: cacertgrpname
options.description: This action will allow to pick CA(s) from the specific CA group, to verify the client certificate.

options.name: certfingerprintdigest
options.description: Digest algorithm used to compute the fingerprint of the client certificate.

options.name: certfingerprintheader
options.description: Name of the header into which to insert the client certificate fingerprint.

options.name: certhashheader
options.description: Name of the header into which to insert the client certificate signature (hash).

options.name: certheader
options.description: Name of the header into which to insert the client certificate.

options.name: certissuerheader
options.description: Name of the header into which to insert the client certificate issuer details.

options.name: certnotafterheader
options.description: Name of the header into which to insert the certificate's expiry date.

options.name: certnotbeforeheader
options.description: Name of the header into which to insert the date and time from which the certificate is valid.

options.name: certserialheader
options.description: Name of the header into which to insert the client serial number.

options.name: certsubjectheader
options.description: Name of the header into which to insert the client certificate subject.

options.name: cipher
options.description: Insert the cipher suite that the client and the Citrix ADC negotiated for the SSL session into the HTTP header of the request being sent to the web server. The appliance inserts the cipher-suite name, SSL protocol, export or non-export string, and cipher strength bit, depending on the type of browser connecting to the SSL virtual server or service (for example, Cipher-Suite: RC4- MD5 SSLv3 Non-Export 128-bit).

options.name: cipherheader
options.description: Name of the header into which to insert the name of the cipher suite.

options.name: clientauth
options.description: Perform client certificate authentication.

options.name: clientcert
options.description: Insert the entire client certificate into the HTTP header of the request being sent to the web server. The certificate is inserted in ASCII (PEM) format.

options.name: clientcertfingerprint
options.description: Insert the certificate's fingerprint into the HTTP header of the request being sent to the web server. The fingerprint is derived by computing the specified hash value (SHA256, for example) of the DER-encoding of the client certificate.

options.name: clientcerthash
options.description: Insert the certificate's signature into the HTTP header of the request being sent to the web server. The signature is the value extracted directly from the X.509 certificate signature field. All X.509 certificates contain a signature field.

options.name: clientcertissuer
options.description: Insert the certificate issuer details into the HTTP header of the request being sent to the web server.

options.name: clientcertnotafter
options.description: Insert the date of expiry of the certificate into the HTTP header of the request being sent to the web server. Every certificate is configured with the date and time at which the certificate expires.

options.name: clientcertnotbefore
options.description: Insert the date from which the certificate is valid into the HTTP header of the request being sent to the web server. Every certificate is configured with the date and time from which it is valid.

options.name: clientcertserialnumber
options.description: Insert the entire client serial number into the HTTP header of the request being sent to the web server.

options.name: clientcertsubject
options.description: Insert the client certificate subject, also known as the distinguished name (DN), into the HTTP header of the request being sent to the web server.

options.name: clientcertverification
options.description: Client certificate verification is mandatory or optional.

options.name: forward
options.description: This action takes an argument a vserver name, to this vserver one will be able to forward all the packets.

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_id
options.description: The ID of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_ip
options.description: The IP of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_name
options.description: The name of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_password
options.description: The password of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_username
options.description: The username of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: name
options.description: Name for the SSL action. Must begin with an ASCII alphanumeric or underscore (_) character, and must contain only ASCII alphanumeric, underscore, hash (#), period (.), space, colon (:), at (@), equals (=), and hyphen (-) characters. Cannot be changed after the action is created.  The following requirement applies only to the Citrix ADC CLI: If the name includes one or more spaces, enclose the name in double or single quotation marks (for example, "my action" or 'my action').

options.name: netscaler_console_as_proxy_server
options.description: The IP address of the NetScaler ADC appliance acting as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: nitro_auth_token
options.description: The authentication token provided by a login operation.

options.name: nitro_pass
options.description: The password with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nitro_protocol
options.description: Which protocol to use when accessing the nitro API objects.

options.name: nitro_user
options.description: The username with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nsip
options.description: The ip address of the NetScaler ADC appliance where the nitro API calls will be made. The port can be specified with the colon (:). E.g. 192.168.1.1:555.

options.name: owasupport
options.description: If the appliance is in front of an Outlook Web Access (OWA) server, insert a special header field, FRONT-END-HTTPS: ON, into the HTTP requests going to the OWA server. This header communicates to the server that the transaction is HTTPS and not HTTP.

options.name: remove_non_updatable_params
options.description: When given yes, the module will remove any parameters that are not updatable in the resource. If no, the module will return error if any non-updatable parameters are provided.

options.name: save_config
options.description: If C(true) the module will save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it makes any changes. The module will not save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it made no changes.

options.name: sessionid
options.description: Insert the SSL session ID into the HTTP header of the request being sent to the web server. Every SSL connection that the client and the Citrix ADC share has a unique ID that identifies the specific connection.

options.name: sessionidheader
options.description: Name of the header into which to insert the Session ID.

options.name: ssllogprofile
options.description: The name of the ssllogprofile.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the resource being configured by the module on the NetScaler ADC node. When C(present), the resource will be added/updated configured according to the module's parameters. When C(absent), the resource will be deleted from the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.
